elements_selected.content: Extend the zetl check command with --drift flag and integrate drift diagnostics into existing check output per CON-019. Changes: 1) Add --drift flag to CheckArgs in cli.rs — when set, show only drift diagnostics; when absent, include drift diagnostics alongside dead links, orphans, syntax errors, spl_diagnostics, 2) Add drift_diagnostics array to the check JSON output schema per CON-019 example, 3) Add drift section to table output, 4) Extend summary counts with drift_warnings and drift_info fields, 5) The existing --fail-on flag applies to drift diagnostics: --fail-on warning exits 1 if any drift warnings exist, --fail-on error exits 1 only on errors, 6) Wire detect_section_drift() call into cmd_check in main.rs — run drift detection after scan and before output. Exit code 0 when no errors; 1 when --fail-on threshold is met.
